findings.rule: Spec §13.11: leaving review progress or Reset cancels old callbacks
findings.observed_before: Confirm stop; review-navigate to TARGET-LOADING then STOPPING; old callback reached personal home after 2.2s.
findings.recommendation: Invalidate attempt on review navigation/Reset/suspend, allowing only the matching product acknowledgement echo.
findings.resolution: Three viewport reentry/Reset/cancel/suspend cases remain in requested scene; real confirmation completes automatically including review-shell echo. Missing assistant-stop acknowledgement remains blocked.

findings.rule: PC-F03 and Spec §13.11 preserve confirmation-based per-circle exit, placed in subscription area
findings.observed_before: Both newly navigable details lacked their own subscription exit path.
findings.recommendation: Add corresponding subscription/confirmation paths while preserving known works and annual rights; do not reuse another circle exit.
findings.resolution: Both circles have explicit correct-target confirmations. Cancel retains membership; confirm removes only that circle and data report last-source availability; search cannot resurrect; Reset restores. Annual text promises no refund result.

checks.observed: Personal/enterprise titles are 我的应用; persistent bottom status/source-count badges removed, creator lines retained. Circle/home product cards share home-app-grid, dimensions, font, padding and radius in observed three viewport samples.

List/empty show no desktop share-link join input/action; four circle rows share 查看详情. Data details contain known report app; annual rights use existing effective date/next-cycle restriction without invented works/creator. Exit is in subscription areas and correct-target confirmation/cancel/recovery checked.

23 final protocol/browser checks cover single confirmation, automatic stop/loading completion, review-only static state, cancel/Reset/leave-reentry/suspend, withheld stop ACK and actual review-shell echo. Progress has no result-selection button.

Assistant token background equals #fbfbfa; clean product has no prototype boundary copy. Review shell visibly distinguishes skill increment vs existing assistant behavior reference at all three viewports. Default UI-refinement story focuses this round.

365 scenes × 3 viewports rendered nonempty with correct scene ID and no document horizontal overflow. Dedicated 39-scene screenshots/DOM captures at each viewport and six review-scope captures had no page errors.

scope: Independent incremental semantic and visual/browser review of Spec §13.11; color/style decisions from prior user request retained.
limitations: This is scoped prototype review, not formal Acceptance, production backend proof or user visual approval.

All 365 scenes received three-viewport availability/overflow checks; detailed screenshots and semantic judgments focus 39 affected/representative scenes. It is not complete manual visual examination of every state.
Missing stop ACK is a controlled prototype peer-protocol fixture with enterprise running state and no answering assistant frame; no real AI execution or backend task termination was tested.
Existing assistant chat/input/attachment/session UI remains governed by current real Renderer, not this simplified prototype. No whole-page or pixel fidelity claim.
Light theme/Chinese and the specified desktop viewports only. No physical desktop application, real payment/refund, persistent membership service or real installation was exercised.
